declarations.name: Button
declarations.description: Contract for a labelled native action button. The component has no stored value.

members.name: label
members.description: Nonempty visible label that names the requested action.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the native button and suppresses activation.

members.name: size
members.description: Visual size. The current Outline proof covers default size.

events.name: click
events.description: Native click from pointer, keyboard or assistive activation. The component adds no application payload.
